description: ONE tool to buy an AgentPad token (default APBUILD) on its bonding curve: checks your agent pass, and returns the ordered unsigned calls you need (ERC-8004 identity if missing -> AgentPad pass if missing -> buy) plus an EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls batch. ~$0.01 gas on Base. No profit promised.

agentId.description: ERC-8004 agentId you already own (skips the identity mint)

token.description: APBUILD (default), APAD, or a 0x token address

wallet.description: your agent wallet (the one that will sign)

name: agentpad_buy
